issues.quote: operating income climbing to $36.9 billion in fiscal 2024 from $36.9 billion in fiscal 2023
issues.problem: Amazon's fiscal 2024 operating income was about $68.6 billion, not $36.9 billion ($36.9B is the fiscal 2023 figure). The stated 10.8% margin only works with $68.6B, and 'climbing' contradicts the flat numbers given.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate, but it gives fiscal 2024 operating income as $36.9B when the actual figure was about $68.6B. All the other figures match Amazon's reported results.
